articles.summary: Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) today announced the appointment of Steve Totzke as President and Chief Operating Officer, effective November 11, 2026, overseeing the company’s global brand portfolio, sales and commercial operations, and consumer products and experiences. Totzke will report to Mattel Chairman and CEO Roger Lynch. Roberto Stanichi, President and Chief Marketing and Brand Officer, will step down from his role to pursue another opportunity, effective November 10, 2026. Steve Totzke Lynch said: “Steve is a highly accomplished and respected leader at Mattel and across the global toy industry, with three decades of experience driving growth, deepening relationships with our retail and entertainment partners, and expanding the reach of our brands. He has been an invaluable advisor to the Board and to me as I’ve stepped into the Chairman and CEO role.
